name: mvplanner
description: One prioritised plan that every agent works from: claim before editing, propose instead of drifting, defer with MVP()/TODO() markers

strictness.title: Strictness
strictness.description: enforce: block edits by agents without a claimed task. warn: only nudge them. off: hooks do nothing.

backend.title: Where the live plan is held
backend.description: git: a branch on the repo's remote, shared by every session and project. file: one plan.json in the main checkout, for a single machine.

branch.title: Plan branch
branch.description: The branch that holds the live plan when the backend is git
